literal_text: Figure 15 Employees want claims and enrollment processes to be further digitized. QUESTION: How important is it to have the following digital/online capabilities available to you? 2023 2025 Ability to submit claims online 57% 65% 59% Ability to enroll in benefits online 65% A mobile app to access benefits information 44% 50% Ability to receive digital/online communications on additional 43% benefits available to me 45% Ability to receive text message notifications and status alerts 39% regarding my benefits (claims status, etc.) 45% Interactive tool to recommend which benefits are right for me 41% 45% Live chat/chatbot to answer questions 33% 32% Note: Data represents the percentage of respondents reporting importance as “very much.”
